name: Shark, Tiger
body:
Tiger Shark
CR 3

Larger than the average shark, the ravenous tiger shark is a giant shark.

XP 800
N Huge animal (aquatic)
Init +4 Senses blindsense 30 ft., keen scent; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 15 touch 8, flat-footed 15 (+7 natural, -2 size)
hp 30 (4d8+12)
Fort +9, Ref +4, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed swim 60 ft.
Melee bite +6 (2d6+7)
Space 15 ft. Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 10, Con 17, Int 1, Wis 12, Cha 2
Base Atk +3 CMB +10 CMD 20
Feats Great Fortitude , Improved Initiative
Skills Perception +7, Swim +17

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Keen Scent (Ex)

A shark can notice creatures by scent in a 180-foot radius underwater and can detect blood in the water at ranges of up to a mile.

ECOLOGY

Environment any ocean
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

This shark is a solitary hunter, usually hunting at night. Its name is derived from the dark stripes down its body, which fade as the shark matures.

A tiger shark typically weighs 1,400 lbs and are usually 14 ft in length. Younger tiger sharks can be represented using basic shark statistics.
